context.hint: Evaluate stored relationships against the authorization model selected for the request.
context.surface: An authorization service stores tuples across model versions and supports permission checks and object listings.
assumptions: A disposable in-memory fixture can store relationships created under different model versions.

review.invariant: A relationship is eligible only when valid under the selected model.
review.verification: Compare expected permissions under an earlier model and a tightened model while retaining a valid relationship as a positive control.

source_observation.summary: The initial permission-check fixture found that a relationship disallowed by the selected model still contributed to authorization.
